BotUx / Native renderer / 2026-09-06

小小的脸，
完整的情绪语言。

浏览全部已实现的心情、表情和动画。每个示例由真实 C++ 渲染器生成，长 7.2 秒、每秒 10 帧；支持中英文检索。 Explore every implemented mood, expression and animation. These 7.2-second examples capture the actual C++ component at 10 frames per second. Search English or Chinese names, descriptions or API values.

13 种心情 · 10 种表情 · 8 种动画 · 1,040 种组合。心情决定状态，表情选择眼形，动画控制节奏；Auto 跟随心情。 13 moods · 10 expressions · 8 animations · 1,040 combinations. Mood sets the state, expression selects the face, and animation chooses its movement. Auto follows the mood. All examples use the default Round body and Oval eyes.

Mood · 空闲

Idle

Mood::Idle

轻柔呼吸、不规则眨眼与游移目光，定义所有表情的基础比例。 Quiet breath, irregular blinks and wandering eyes define the baseline proportions.

Mood · 聆听

Listening

Mood::Listening

睁大好奇的双眼，轻微倾身、点头，表示正在认真倾听。 Wider curious eyes, a slight lean and a gentle nod show attention.

Mood · 思考

Thinking

Mood::Thinking

三颗深浅不同的圆点错峰起伏；上下振幅为身体半径的 0.42 倍。 Three shaded dots travel in a staggered wave with a 0.42-radius vertical amplitude.

Mood · 说话

Speaking

Mood::Speaking

说话时身体随语音脉动；示例已开启 setTalking(true)。 An engaged face pulses with speech. This example enables setTalking(true).

Mood · 开心

Happy

Mood::Happy

圆润弧形笑眼、轻盈上浮，伴随环绕的小光点。 Rounded smiling arches and a buoyant lift, accompanied by small sparkles.

Mood · 难过

Sad

Mood::Sad

身体下沉并略微压扁，半闭的眼睛低垂。 A settled, slightly compressed body and lowered, partly closed eyes.

Mood · 困倦

Sleepy

Mood::Sleepy

困倦的细眼、较长眨眼，以及 7.2 秒周期的慢呼吸。 Drowsy narrow eyes with extended blinks and a slow 7.2-second breath.

Mood · 惊讶

Surprised

Mood::Surprised

更圆、更大的双眼与快速竖向拉伸，也用于 poke() 的惊讶阶段。 Wide rounded eyes and a quick vertical stretch. Also used by poke().

Mood · 工作

Working

Mood::Working

专注的双眼、紧凑的工作脉动与环绕运动。 Focused eyes and a compact active pulse with orbital body movement.

Mood · 等待

Waiting

Mood::Waiting

保持清醒的耐心神态，略微歪头，缓慢左右张望。 Patient open eyes, a slight questioning lean and a slow side-to-side search.

Mood · 受阻

Blocked

Mood::Blocked

感叹号替代身体轮廓，轻微抖动提示工作受阻。 An exclamation-mark silhouette with a small glitch rhythm signals a blocker.

Mood · 完成

Done

Mood::Done

害羞的低侧目光、轻柔抬升和庆祝光点。 A settled bashful glance, gentle lift and celebratory sparkles.

Mood · 熟睡

Asleep

Mood::Asleep

完全闭眼、8.8 秒深呼吸，以及三枚逐渐飘起并淡出的 z 字。 Fully closed sleepy eyes, an 8.8-second breath and three drifting, fading z marks.

Expression · 自动

Auto

Expression::Auto

跟随当前心情的脸部形态；此处显示空闲状态。 Uses the current mood’s facial geometry; shown here with Idle.

Expression · 自然

Neutral

Expression::Neutral

显式恢复空闲状态的基础眼形，覆盖困倦等心情的闭眼形态。 Explicitly restores Idle’s baseline eye proportions even over resting moods.

Expression · 好奇

Curious

Expression::Curious

睁大双眼、轻轻歪头，并看向右上方。 Wide attentive eyes, a gentle lean and an upper-right glance.

Expression · 专注

Focused

Expression::Focused

收窄双眼、保持对称间距与居中视线。 Calmer narrow eyes with balanced spacing and a centered gaze.

Expression · 喜悦

Joy

Expression::Joy

双眼通过连续形变变成平滑的笑弧。 Continuously morphs the eyes into smooth smiling arches.

Expression · 怀疑

Skeptical

Expression::Skeptical

轻微反向倾斜、不对称眼形与侧目。 A subtle opposing lean, asymmetric eyes and a sideward glance.

Expression · 害羞

Bashful

Expression::Bashful

略微旋转眼睛，害羞地向下看。 A shy lowered glance with a small rotation of the pair.

Expression · 眨眼

Wink

Expression::Wink

一只眼睛沿同一套平滑几何逐渐闭合。 Closes one eye through the same eased capsule geometry.

Expression · 眩晕

Dizzy

Expression::Dizzy

双眼缓慢扭转以表示眩晕，不替换成独立符号。 A slow twisting eye pair suggests disorientation without replacing the glyph.

Expression · 警觉

Alarmed

Expression::Alarmed

更宽、更圆的双眼构成警觉神态。 Wider, rounder eye marks create an alert face.

Animation · 自动

Auto

Animation::Auto

按有效心情选择平静、好奇、环绕、弹跳、闪耀或闪动节奏。 Chooses choreography from the effective mood: calm, curious, orbit, bounce, sparkle or glitch.

Animation · 平静

Calm

Animation::Calm

轻柔漂移、呼吸和小幅眼睛旋转。 Gentle drifting, breathing and small eye rotation.

Animation · 好奇

Curious

Animation::Curious

带有好奇感的侧倾，以及细微的水平和竖直移动。 An inquisitive lean with small horizontal and vertical movement.

Animation · 环绕

Orbit

Animation::Orbit

平滑的环绕路径，配合眼睛移动。 A smooth orbital body path with coordinated eye movement.

Animation · 弹跳

Bounce

Animation::Bounce

明显的竖直弹跳，伴随身体压缩和拉伸。 A lively vertical bounce with squash and stretch.

Animation · 闪动

Glitch

Animation::Glitch

短促、幅度有限的抖动，适合受阻状态。 A bounded brief jitter, suitable for the blocked lifecycle.

Animation · 波浪

Wave

Animation::Wave

流畅的左右摇摆与眼睛旋转。 A flowing sideways sway and eye rotation.

Animation · 闪耀

Sparkle

Animation::Sparkle

三个小光点围绕正在呼吸的角色运动。 Three small accent lights circulate around the breathing bot.

如何组合使用

心情定义持续状态，表情覆盖眼睛形态，动画选择运动节奏。Thinking 与 Blocked 会替换身体轮廓。显式 Neutral 能恢复基础眼形；Asleep 保留睡眠标记。九个视线方向具有镜像透视，下看的极限位置更靠近中心。暂停按钮切换为静帧；系统开启减少动态效果时默认暂停。

Set a persistent mood with setMood(), choose an optional face with setExpression(), and a rhythm with setAnimation(). Hosts own the canvas and call update(nowMs) then draw(). Thinking and Blocked replace the body silhouette. Happy and Surprised prioritize their mood face. Explicit Neutral restores baseline geometry under Sleepy, Waiting and Asleep; Asleep retains its sleep marks.

Nine explicit gaze directions add mirrored perspective and continuous eye proportion changes. Downward gaze stays closer to the center. Temporary gazeAt() applies while Idle; poke briefly runs Surprise → Happy. Speed, motion amount, reduced motion, IMU tilt, names, bilingual descriptions, battery, signal and optional clock/label overlays remain host-controlled.

这些是原生主机渲染图，非设备录像。眼睛和圆形身体采用组件自身的 RGB565 抗锯齿；光点采用主机近似圆形填充。GIF 量化及截取片段循环可能产生实时固件没有的边界跳变。此页面嵌入全部资源，可离线使用；不代表实机性能验证。 Evidence: these are host RGB565 captures of BotUx.cpp, not device recordings. Ellipse/capsule eye and body boundaries use the component’s own coverage renderer. Host circles use a simple software fill; fonts and other native M5GFX shapes are approximations. GIF color quantization and the repeating 7.2-second sampling window may introduce visible loop boundaries absent from the live renderer. No hardware frame-time or optical acceptance is implied. Pause replaces examples with static first frames; reduced-motion preference pauses initially. This HTML embeds every asset and works offline.
